name: Repostit Clips
tagline: Turn long YouTube videos into short social clips.
description: Repostit Clips helps creators and teams repurpose long YouTube videos into short social clips. Paste a video link to identify potential highlight moments, then review their scores and adjust clip start and end points in the manual editor. Export vertical 1080 × 1920 videos and schedule them to connected social platforms. The free account includes up to 10 videos or 100 minutes of source video; paid plans provide higher monthly processing limits.
